name: Stripe Connect Platform Account
description: Stripe Connect Platform Account is the financial platform identity used to onboard connected accounts, configure responsibility, act in their account context and route payments or payouts between parties.
agentUseSummary: This multiparty financial-control model is visible as a canonical Stripe extension preview. Relay will not collect platform keys, onboard sellers or expose Connect money movement beside the bounded canonical Stripe reads.

capabilities.label: Use a Stripe Connect platform
capabilities.description: If Connect support is approved, extend the canonical Stripe connector with immutable platform, connected-account, mode, controller, responsibility and capability binding.

blocked.label: Create duplicate Stripe provider state
blocked.description: A Connect platform listing must not create parallel account tokens, tools or approvals beside Relay's canonical Stripe connector.

blocked.label: Capture Stripe platform credentials
blocked.description: Relay will not ask a platform operator to paste secret keys, Connect client secrets or connected-account tokens into this Marketplace alias.

blocked.label: Onboard or verify connected accounts
blocked.description: Creating accounts, collecting identity information, accepting agreements, enabling capabilities and satisfying KYC requirements are regulated operator workflows outside Relay agent actions.

blocked.label: Move funds or change platform controls
blocked.description: Charges, transfers, application fees, refunds, payouts, reserves, payout schedules, external accounts, loss liability and fraud controls are unavailable.

blocked.label: Run Stripe Connect actions from the setup alias
blocked.description: This alias exposes no runtime actions; any approved support must extend the canonical connector with exact platform, connected-account, mode and financial-policy binding.

approvalProfiles.label: Stripe Connect financial-control review
approvalProfiles.description: This platform alias is not connectable. Connected-account authority remains unavailable until Relay has a legally reviewed, least-privilege and auditable Connect product design.

runtimeSupport.description: This alias installs no OpenClaw tools; Connect authority must extend the canonical Stripe provider pack after financial review.
This alias installs no Hermes tools; Connect authority must extend the canonical Stripe provider pack after financial review.

providerSetup.blocker: Stripe Connect gives a platform multiparty financial authority: it can onboard connected accounts, select controller responsibilities, make account-context API calls, route payments, transfer or pay out funds, collect fees and sometimes own negative-balance or fraud liability. Relay's canonical Stripe connector intentionally excludes Connect and customer platform credentials.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep using the canonical Stripe App for bounded balance and PaymentIntent reads. Any Connect product requires separate legal, compliance and financial-risk approval; immutable platform/account/mode/controller binding; Stripe-hosted onboarding; direct provider handling of PII; explicit capabilities; no secret capture; dual control for money movement; limits, reconciliation, idempotency, webhook audit, revocation and typed tools.

evidence.supports: Stripe describes Connect platforms as onboarding sellers, managing connected accounts, routing payments, controlling payouts and using platform API keys to act for connected accounts.
Stripe requires server requests for connected accounts to bind an exact acct_ identifier in the Stripe-Account header with the platform secret key.
Stripe recommends hosted or embedded onboarding so changing verification requirements and identity-document collection remain provider-controlled.
Stripe controller properties determine Dashboard access, fee collection and whether Stripe or the platform bears negative-balance, payment, fraud and dispute responsibility.
